description: This file defines a class for compiling the {include_php} tag in Smarty templates, including methods for handling attributes, security checks, and generating the PHP code to include external PHP files based on template tags.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include_Php
classes.description: A class that compiles the {include_php} Smarty template tag into executable PHP code, handling security, attributes, and file inclusion.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to include another PHP file based on the attributes provided in the Smarty template tag, performing security checks and handling optional parameters.
